# PowerPlay v2.0.0 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Introduce PowerPlay's new official blue-purple equilateral right-facing play glyph with the metallic P and cyan lightning strike.
- Align the Fire TV launcher icon, startup splash, Android TV banners, README artwork, compact glyphs and companion PowerLink design system.
- Refresh visible app and platform wording from inherited Plezy branding to PowerPlay, while retaining required upstream attribution.
- Preserve existing PowerShuffle behavior, queue handoff, HD/4K matching, paired Fire TV devices, Android application ID, and `powerplay://` deep links.
- No intentional breaking changes to stored user settings or PowerLink protocol.
- Remove the upstream Plezy crash-reporting destination; optional PowerPlay diagnostics now require an explicitly configured endpoint.

## Compatibility

PowerShuffle continues to require PowerLink 0.3.0 or later. PowerLink 1.0.0 ships the matching branding; all existing compatible queue and pairing behavior should remain intact. Existing alternate icon style selections are preserved.
